description: Fueled by curiosity and caffeine, our team of young robotics engineers is heading to the NASA hackathon to turn bold ideas into working machines. Blending skills in mechanics, embedded systems, and AI navigation, we approach every challenge with an engineer's precision and an explorer's imagination. For us, this hackathon is our first giant leap toward the future stars.
summary: We developed a system that helps astronauts navigate in the extremely difficult enviroment of Mars. We combined already existing solutions дшлу satellites, and automated robotic systems that are already great at gathering information- into one system that provides vital support for navigation on the Red Planet
details: Our project integrates orbital satellite mapping with an autonomous scout fleet of rovers and hexacopters to collect real-time environmental telemetry in Gale Crater, dynamically delivering the safest and most resource-efficient navigation routes directly to an astronaut's application.
